name: SQL Query
description: Runs one read-only SELECT/WITH query over the connected input tables. Each entry of 'inputs' names the input of that port as a SQL table (quote it when the node id is not a plain identifier). The output schema is read with SELECT * FROM (<sql>) LIMIT 0; LIST, STRUCT, MAP and TIMESTAMPTZ columns are rejected. DDL/DML (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, ATTACH, DETACH, COPY, INSTALL, LOAD, PRAGMA, SET, EXPORT, IMPORT, CALL) and multiple statements are rejected before the query runs; the result is capped by 'limit'.

sql.title: SQL
sql.description: One read-only SELECT or WITH statement over the tables named by 'inputs'.
sql.placeholder: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM src GROUP BY category

inputs.title: Input tables
inputs.description: Node ids of the connected inputs in port order; each id becomes a SQL table name for the query.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum number of rows the node returns; 10000 by default, at most 1000000.
